blocks.text: AI is like a patient foreign-language teacher who's always there. You can practise conversation, words and grammar – without feeling embarrassed.
Important: Claude is for adults (18+). So practise the Claude lessons together with a parent, who uses their own account.
Important: you may use ChatGPT from age 13 and only with a parent's permission. If you're younger, practise together with a parent.
Important: you need a parent's permission for Gemini. Younger children can use it only through a parent's Family Link account, where available.

items: Conversation: "Talk with me in Spanish about football, using simple words, and gently correct me."
Words: ask for 10 new words with example sentences.
Game: "Give me a word in English and I'll translate it."
Grammar: ask for an explanation with lots of examples.

blocks.text: I'm 12 and learning Spanish. Let's talk about my favourite film. Ask me simple questions in Spanish, one at a time, and when I make a mistake, correct me and explain in English.
10 minutes every day is better than an hour once a week.
Some AI tools have a voice mode, so you can also talk out loud. Ask a parent to help you turn it on.
